title: RBLA+: Efficient Rank-Specific LoRA Adapter Extraction for Federated Fine-Tuning with Heterogeneous Clients
abstract: arXiv:2611.12961v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated fine-tuning with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces communication and computational overhead by training and exchanging compact trainable LoRA factors. Clients may use different LoRA ranks to meet adapter communication budgets and accommodate different local adaptation needs. The server must process these differences during aggregation and construct adapters at each client's rank for local training. We distinguish pre-aggregation alignment, which handles factor dimensions and scaling conventions before aggregation and rank-specific LoRA adapter extraction, which constructs client-sized pairs from the aggregated global model. Two common approaches to rank-specific extraction are direct rank truncation and Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) of the dense update. translated_title: RBLA+：面向异构客户端联邦微调的高效特定秩 LoRA 适配器提取
translated_abstract: 基于低秩适配的联邦微调通过训练并交换紧凑的可训练 LoRA 因子，降低了通信和计算开销。客户端可能使用不同的 LoRA 秩，以满足适配器通信预算并适应不同的本地适配需求。服务器必须在聚合过程中处理这些差异，并按每个客户端的秩构建适配器用于本地训练。我们区分了两个环节：预聚合对齐（在聚合之前处理因子维度和缩放约定）与特定秩 LoRA 适配器提取（从聚合后的全局模型中构建与客户端规模相匹配的参数对）。特定秩提取的两种常见方法是直接秩截断和对稠密更新进行奇异值分解（SVD）。直接前缀截断保留一个聚合因子的前导列和另一个因子的对应行，虽然代价低，但可能增大重建误差。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出RBLA+方法，为客户端LoRA秩异构的联邦微调实现高效的特定秩适配器提取，在低计算开销的同时控制重建误差。
en_tdlr: RBLA+ enables efficient rank-specific LoRA adapter extraction for federated fine-tuning with heterogeneous-client LoRA ranks, achieving low overhead while limiting reconstruction error.
